# Broad Institute

> The Broad Institute is a leading biomedical research organization advancing genomics, chemical biology, and psychiatric neuroscience through collaborative discovery and innovation.

The Broad Institute, affiliated with MIT and Harvard, conducts cutting-edge research across genomics, drug discovery, and brain disease mechanisms. The organization supports a vibrant community of core researchers, postdoctoral fellows, and summer scholars pursuing breakthroughs in cancer biology, psychiatric disorders, and computational biology.

## Key Topics

- Single-cell genomics
- Chemical biology
- Psychiatric research
- Cancer drug discovery
- CRISPR screening
- Neuroscience
- Bioinformatics
- Machine learning
- Natural products
- Protein degradation
- Brain disease genomics
- Summer Scholars Program
- Stanley Center for Psychiatric Research
- PRISM platform
- Computational biology

## Core Leadership & Senior Researchers

- [Evan Macosko](https://www.broadinstitute.org/bios/evan-macosko): Core institute member and Edward Scolnick Professor studying genomics of brain diseases
- [Stuart L. Schreiber](https://www.broadinstitute.org/bios/stuart-l-schreiber): Founding core member emeritus pioneering chemical biology and protein degradation research
- [Guoping Feng](https://www.broadinstitute.org/bios/guoping-feng): Institute member and director studying synaptic function and psychiatric brain disorders
- [Jon Clardy](https://www.broadinstitute.org/bios/jon-clardy): Researcher focused on natural products, antimalarial compounds, and chemical biology

## Research Scientists & Specialists

- [Charles Vanderburg](https://www.broadinstitute.org/bios/charles-vanderburg): Senior research scientist in Macosko Lab specializing in neuroanatomy and single-cell genomics
- [Laura Doherty](https://www.broadinstitute.org/bios/laura-doherty): Research scientist on PRISM platform studying cancer drug mechanisms and biomarkers

## Postdoctoral Fellows & Advanced Researchers

- [Eric Garcia](https://www.broadinstitute.org/bios/eric-garcia): Profile of Eric Garcia, BSRP fellow studying Alzheimer's genes via differential expression analysis
- [Parmida Davarmanesh](https://www.broadinstitute.org/bios/parmida-davarmanesh): University of Michigan researcher applying GANs to 3D fluorescent microscopy imaging
- [Eric Bueno](https://www.broadinstitute.org/bios/eric-bueno): UConn researcher developing machine learning pipeline for cell nuclei segmentation
- [Maria Lysandrou](https://www.broadinstitute.org/bios/maria-lysandrou): University of Chicago researcher analyzing olfactory receptor spatial distribution

## Summer Scholars & Student Researchers

- [Tess](https://www.broadinstitute.org/bios/tess): Summer Scholars Program student mentored by Andrew Allen in psychiatric research
- [Dain Ruiz](https://www.broadinstitute.org/bios/dain-ruiz): UNC student researcher studying post-translational modifications in Down syndrome
- [Jimmy](https://www.broadinstitute.org/bios/jimmy): Summer Scholars Program student researching cancer and JQ1 drug mechanisms
- [Khush](https://www.broadinstitute.org/bios/khush): BSSP student studying mitochondrial protein METTL17 and bioenergetics
- [Robert](https://www.broadinstitute.org/bios/robert): Summer intern in Regev Lab researching single-cell analysis and microfluidics
- [Jeffrey](https://www.broadinstitute.org/bios/jeffrey): BSSP intern studying CRISPR screening and combination therapy in breast cancer
- [Anaka](https://www.broadinstitute.org/bios/anaka): Student researcher in Regev Lab studying DNA sequencing and optical screening
- [Everianny](https://www.broadinstitute.org/bios/everianny): BSSP high school intern researching ADAR1 inhibitors for cancer therapy
- [Yuen Ler](https://www.broadinstitute.org/bios/yuen-ler): BSSP fellow applying machine learning to drug mechanism of action in imaging

## Creative & Interdisciplinary Work

- [Naoe Suzuki](https://www.broadinstitute.org/bios/naoe-suzuki): Fifth artist-in-residence exploring intersection of science and visual art
